name: gravitybridge
description: One-click Google Antigravity subagents for Codex, with verified routing and reversible local configuration

scripts.dev: GRAVITYBRIDGE_MODE=1 OPENCODEX_HOME=~/.gravitybridge bun run src/cli/index.ts start
scripts.test:product: bun scripts/test.ts tests/gravitybridge-core.test.ts tests/gravitybridge-routes.test.ts tests/gravitybridge-cli.test.ts tests/antigravity-baseurl-override.test.ts tests/antigravity-static-catalog.test.ts tests/google-antigravity-oauth.test.ts tests/google-antigravity-replay.test.ts tests/google-antigravity-wire.test.ts tests/subagent-defaults.test.ts tests/subagent-fallback-handle-responses.test.ts tests/subagent-model-fallback-api.test.ts tests/subagent-model-fallback.test.ts tests/subagent-roster-retention.test.ts tests/codex-inject.test.ts tests/codex-inject-integration.test.ts tests/oauth-callback-server.test.ts tests/oauth-login-open-browser.test.ts tests/server-management-auth.test.ts
scripts.audit:high: bun audit --audit-level=high && cd gui && bun audit --audit-level=high
scripts.build:gui: cd gui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build:gravitybridge && cd .. && bun run prepare:package
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run audit:high && bun run typecheck && bun run build:gui
scripts.prepush: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:gui:if-changed && bun run test && bun run privacy:scan && bun run doctor:gui:if-changed
